task.description:
Implement the five task operation endpoints for API-04 in src/api/routes/tasks.zig.

Read src/design/api-04-task-operations.md in full before starting.

Endpoints to implement:
1. GET /tasks - list with cursor pagination and assignee_id/status/instance_id filters; TASK_WORKER sees only own tasks, PROCESS_OPERATOR+ sees all.
2. GET /tasks/:id - returns full task record, HTTP 404 if not found.
3. POST /tasks/:id/complete - delegates to existing EE-04 completeTask logic; TASK_WORKER ownership check (HTTP 403); HTTP 409 if already completed/cancelled.
4. POST /tasks/:id/assign - assigns unassigned task to a user; PROCESS_OPERATOR+ only; HTTP 409 if already assigned.
5. POST /tasks/:id/reassign - changes assignee of assigned task; PROCESS_OPERATOR+ only; HTTP 409 if not currently assigned.

Also add any required TaskStore methods (listCursor, assign, reassign) to src/tasks/ if they do not already exist.

Register all new routes in the router. Run zig build and zig build test. Both must exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: All five API-04 endpoints implemented in src/api/routes/tasks.zig
TASK_WORKER visibility filter applied to GET /tasks
Role check (PROCESS_OPERATOR+) enforced on assign and reassign
HTTP 409 on complete of already-completed/cancelled task
HTTP 409 on assign of already-assigned task
HTTP 409 on reassign of unassigned task
HTTP 403 when TASK_WORKER completes another users task

result.summary: Implemented API-04 task operations: handleList (cursor pagination, role-based filtering), handleGetById, handleComplete (actor ownership check), handleAssign, handleReassign. Added AssignError, ListCursorParams, listCursor(), assign(), reassign() to TaskStore. Updated test_tasks_api.zig to match new handler signatures.
